617:t_001:55.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「The feelings of Earth's people, who won't flinch even before a mighty enemy, are pushing $c forward right now!」

617:t_001:56.en:
$$刹那$$
「And humanity will advance! Past you who stand in the way of our future!」

617:t_001:58.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Then prove it. After that, we'll take you on.」

617:t_001:59.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll carve wounds into the bodies of you incompetents who can't understand our words, and make you understand.」

617:t_001:60.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We're not going to flinch at threats like that now!」

617:t_001:61.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no intention of obeying you.」

617:t_001:62.en:
$$ランド$$
「Fine! We came here ready and raring to fight from the start!」

617:t_001:64.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Today is the $$新地球皇国$$'s last day!」

617:t_001:65.en:
$$バサラ$$
「The stage that will set our souls ablaze begins now!!」

617:t_002:0.en:
$$キラ$$
($$カガリ$$... I'm coming to save you now.)

617:t_002:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
($$ナナリー$$...! Please wait just a little longer!)

617:t_002:2.en:
$$刹那$$
($$マリナ・イスマイール$$... The world needs people like you.)

617:t_002:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n...! Are you feeling all right?!」

617:t_002:4.en:
$n
「The $$血塗られた眼$$ haven't appeared so far!」

617:t_002:5.en:
$n
(I don't know how the $$霊子吸収システム$$ in that Imperial Palace is connected to the $$血塗られた眼$$...)

617:t_002:6.en:
$n
(But right now, I have to advance...! With everything on the line!)

617:t_002:7.en:
$n
「Here I come, $$エルーナルーナ$$! $$尸空#pilot$$, $$バルビエル$$! First, we'll drag you out!」

617:t_003:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Another nuisance has arrived.」

617:t_004:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「That bastard...! Did he come to help the Empire?!」

617:t_004:2.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I told you. I'm not with $$ジェミニス$$ or $$サイデリアル$$ anymore.」

617:t_004:5.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「But first, I have to thank you.」

617:t_004:7.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「You certainly killed $$アンナロッタ$$.」

617:t_004:9.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「But you didn't touch the $$ジェミニス$$ around her, or the baby in her belly.」

617:t_004:10.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「My assignment was to eliminate $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$, the last woman, if $$ジェミニス$$ defied Heaven's will.」

617:t_004:12.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Thanks to that, $$アンナロッタ$$'s and my daughters... the hope of the $$ジェミナイド$$s... were born. Twins, at that.」

617:t_004:13.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I named them $$アンナ$$ and $$ロッタ$$. When they grow up, the $$ジェミナイド$$s can pass their blood on to the next generation.」

617:t_004:16.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「But listen! Orders or not, I won't forgive you for killing $$アンナロッタ$$!!」

617:t_004:17.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I'll crush you! You... and $$サイデリアル$$! And...!」

617:t_004:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「In the end, you're a half-baked $$リアクター|lc$$ who never brought the $$いがみ合う双子$$ to the true Third Stage.」

617:t_004:20.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「For a man like you to defy us is sheer presumption.」

617:t_004:21.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Fine, $$バルビエル$$. I was always going to fight a lapdog like you sooner or later!」

617:t_004:22.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「$$エルーナルーナ$$ and $$アウストラリス$$, too, of course!」

617:t_004:23.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Is that why you stole the spear, $$ガドライト#pilot$$?」

617:t_004:25.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「That's right. The spear you have, which distorts causality, was being kept by $$サイデリアル$$...」

617:t_004:26.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「And the one who gave it to $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ was him... $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$.」

617:t_004:27.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「The $$クィーン$$, huh. So you sided with $c in the end.」

617:t_004:28.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Whatever else I might say, I love this planet, too.」

617:t_004:29.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Heh... Humans never lose their feelings for the planet they were born on, no matter what happens.」

617:t_004:30.en:
$$桂$$
「It seems $$ガドライト#pilot$$ was also the one passing inside information on the Empire to $$ツィーネ$$.」

617:t_004:31.en:
$$デュオ$$
「He used to be with $$サイデリアル$$. So he had connections there.」

617:t_004:32.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「OK, $$ガドライト#pilot$$. Without a $$スフィア$$, we have no lingering attachment to you, either.」

617:t_004:33.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「It's a pity. If only you had more power.」

617:t_004:34.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Shut up. Even without a $$スフィア$$, don't think I'm the same man who drank himself stupid in a swamp of resignation.」

617:t_004:36.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Don't say anything unnecessary, $n. I'm just doing what I want.」

617:t_004:37.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「But I'll thank you. Your presence reminded me to keep struggling.」

617:t_004:38.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$... So you've regained your pride.」

617:t_004:40.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Prepare yourselves, $$サイデリアル$$! Feel the fury of a man you've kept taking everything from!」

617:t_004:41.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「For my dead wife! For $$アンナ$$, $$ロッタ$$... and the $$ジェミナイド$$s' tomorrow! I'll crush you!」

617:t_005:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「We've defeated the three $$リアクター|lc$$s!」

617:t_005:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Only $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ remains!」

617:t_005:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「The ruler of the $$新地球皇国$$...! Will he finally show himself?!」

617:t_007:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「That's right. That is $$皇帝アウストラリス$$.」

617:t_007:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You could say that ball is the man himself.」

617:t_007:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「You just don't learn! You're back again!」

617:t_007:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Damn it! Are they going to regenerate their machines with the $$スフィア$$s' $$次元力$$?!」

617:t_007:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Too bad, $$セツコ$$! You should have finished me off then instead of letting pathetic sympathy sway you!」

617:t_007:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$! You're still saying things like that?!」

617:t_007:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now, $$アウストラリス$$! We'll buy you time! While we do... 」

617:t_008:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$アウストラリス$$! What are you...?!」

617:t_008:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「He just... shot his own allies?!」

617:t_008:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't tell me you...! Our...」
